report.headline: 138 collectible tests this pass (command-center/, 2 non-hermetic salvage/scratch trees excluded, see fixtures/collectible_scope.py). Probe1 raw (3 shuffled seeds [1001, 2002, 5005], shuffle-actually-reordered control=True): 1 candidate(s) that passed at baseline and failed under at least one shuffle. Probe2 (5 identical-order repeats, order-held-constant control=True): 1 test(s) that disagree with themselves even with order held constant. Cross-referencing the two (the catalog's own point: a single shuffled failure alone cannot tell order-dependence apart from plain nondeterminism): 0 of the 1 probe1 candidate(s) are ALSO flaky under a held-constant order and are therefore flake, not order-dependence, leaving 1 genuinely order-dependent test(s) this pass. All flagged tests in both categories are the deliberately planted ground-truth fixtures (real 135-test corpus: 0 order-dependent, 0 flaky this pass). Detection method proven live: both ground-truth fixtures were caught and correctly classified (probe1_ground_truth_ok=True, probe2_ground_truth_ok=True).

reviewer.notes: Headline reproduced across repeated independent re-runs (not just this review's canonical pair): baseline_collected=138 (stable, 6/6 probe1 runs + 3/3 probe2 runs); shuffle_control_ok=True (6/6); ground_truth_ok=True for both probes (6/6 and 3/3); genuine_order_dependent_count=1 -- test_b_requires_writer_flag, the planted fixture -- INVARIANT across all 6 probe1 runs; flake_explained_count varied 0-1 per run purely because the planted flaky fixture's OS-entropy draw only sometimes lands in the shuffle-fail/baseline-pass pattern probe1 screens for (observed both flake_explained_count=1, matching the pre-existing artifact almost verbatim including the seed=2002/5005 detail, and flake_explained_count=0 across different runs of this review) -- this variability is expected and is itself evidence the flaky ground-truth fixture is genuinely nondeterministic rather than hard-coded, and evidence the cross-reference step against probe2 is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. Real 135-test corpus: 0 order-dependent, 0 flaky, confirmed across every re-run in this review (9 total probe invocations). Verdict: PASS -- the headline order-dependent/flake counts and the underlying detection methodology survive an independent fresh-context attempt to falsify them.
